status: negative development ablation; do not adopt pruning
representation_tested: per-skill enrichment terms ranked by enrichment-document IDF * (1 + ln(tf)); top K unique terms retained once; canonical C0 untouched
decision: Reject discriminative keyword pruning. The best-looking development setting (K=128) slightly improves the older first slice and synthetic stress while materially regressing the second natural holdout from 85% to 75%. Smaller K values regress further. The full human-training text remains the safer representation.
next_question: The clean Städmaterial residual requires genuinely missing semantic language, not document-noise reduction. Any next candidate must add build-time semantic representation without benchmark-query ingestion and must earn promotion on a new unopened source-attested holdout.
